zusammenfassung: The first calendar week of 2026 brings a wave of new AI tools. A systematic review of more than ten leading sources identified over 80 new AI tools. The five most promising were selected for in-depth analysis. The week is defined by specialisation, infrastructure and user experience.
highlights: Stars of the week: Nano Banana and Mnexium AI (9/10)
Trend: character consistency and persistent memory
Shift: from all-in-one to specialised solutions
